planDay.title: Playground practice
planDay.instructions: Visit the playground for twenty minutes. Practise waiting for a turn on the slide.

clinicianTips.title: Praise effort
clinicianTips.body: Say what Kavi did well in a few simple words, right after he does it.

clinicianTips.title: Offer a choice
clinicianTips.body: Offer two options instead of an open question to reduce stress.

clinicianTips.title: Short instructions
clinicianTips.body: Use one short instruction at a time and wait for a response.
